s: After here there are a few difficult fights. Make sure you have 3-4 party members. Nern, Olan and Rage are your best bet here. Once obtained, train them up in the cave to New Roads on the infinite spawning shadowy figures as you will probably not be strong enough yet.

t: New Roads | Lisa RPG Wiki | Fandom
s: If you feel you cannot take on Steve as well as the Rando Army guys, fight the men by themselves and then walk to the right to fight Steve. It is recommender to have 3-4 party members levelled to around 4-6 to stand a chance. The Black out Cave is a fantastic spot to farm before coming here.
